text:
lee: Quick note — onboarding NimbusX (llama-ish) hit a reproducible offset after vocab conversion + rotary mode switch. Anyone seen token-index leaks?

anya: show the convert flags and a tiny failing prefix?

lee: convert: `python tools/convert.py --src=llama --dst=redwood --vocab=legacy-v2.json --rotary=wrap-perhead --merge-sentinels=true`
failing prompt: "A quick brown fox" -> logits spike at an unexpected subtoken, then attention drifts for 2 steps.

sam: dump token ids for the prefix pls — looks like a merged sentinel to me.

lee: ids: [11, 204, 77, 3300] where 3300 should expand to [3300, 12] in legacy map but was merged.

devon: merging alters the position stream; rotary phases computed per position will shift. Also kv-cache indices assume stable segmentation. Did you trace warmup offsets?

lee: yes: `kv_pos_expected=56 kv_pos_actual=58` consistently after the merged id.

triage-bot: nightly conversion sweep summary: NimbusX PPL +2.6 short-context; stitch-suite fail 3.9%. Artifacts: /runs/1829/nimbus-convert/01

anya: workaround: demerge table during conversion (expand merged ids back). Not ideal but fixes offsets. Patch branch `wip/demerge-nimbus`.

sam: I'll run quick quant sensitivity (fp16 -> int8 -> int4) against the demerge branch tonight and post numbers.

devon: long-term: canonicalize converter to preserve segmentation semantics and make rotary indexing derive phase from absolute subtoken positions instead of merged token indices. Filing ML-2479.

lee: added minimal repro + sample token map to ML-2479. I'll include a unit test asserting kv_pos stability for first 24 warmup steps.

sam: noted — will attach int4 deltas tomorrow.

devon: thanks. if quant amplifies we prioritize ML-2479; otherwise demerge is acceptable short-term.

anya: also add a grep scan for maps with merge-sentinels=true so we can queue rebuilds. short script in the ticket.

triage-bot: ML-2479 created and assigned to dev:devon; reporter: lee; priority:high.
